full_judgment: 4. In writ petition No. 342 of 1977 it is stated that she is the widow of Keshab Lal Das. The said Keshab Lal Das had another brother Benode Lal who died unmarried and childless and his property devolved upon his brother Keshab Lal Das. It is stated that in pursuance of Article 7 of President's Order the Petitioner submitted her return claiming 28.23 acres out of 47.22 acres of khas land of mouza Mustafapur, P. S. Rampal, District Khulna. It is stated that when the petitioner was awaiting acceptance of her return she came to know of a report of the Sub-Divisional Manager who recommended the taking possession of 11'24 acres and for taking action under article 8 on the ground that she has made a false return. This petitioner also filed an application for further enquiry on the ground that there had been no inquiry by the Sub-Divisional Officer or any other Revenue Officer. This petition was marked as Misc. Appeal and it was disposed of on 3.12.75 directing the authority to take possession of 18.7.77 acres of land. The petitioner filed an appeal before the respondent No. 1 who however dismissed the appeal by holding that the Binapani actually belonged to one family and it is merely an attempt on the part of Manindra to avoid surrender of those excess lands. It is stated that she did not belong to the joint family of Manindra, Sachindra or Durgamoni.
